identity.name: Spirit Zulu Time GMT 39mm
identity.one_liner: The Longines Spirit Zulu Time — 39mm, GMT, bi-directional ceramic bezel, 72-hour reserve, COSC-certified. The most-cited Asian entry-luxury GMT of the early 2020s.

provenance_events.description: Longines releases the Spirit Zulu Time as a 39mm GMT with a 24-hour ceramic bezel, L844.4 calibre.

narrative.story: The Spirit Zulu Time is Longines's modern GMT — a 39mm steel case, a 24-hour ceramic bezel, a black or blue dial, the in-house L844.4 automatic with 72 hours of reserve and COSC certification.
narrative.collector_notes: The L844.4 is one of the most-cited entry-luxury GMT movements: COSC-certified, 72-hour reserve, flyable.
